<DOCSTRING>
Binds a signer to a timestamp and tests the max age for signature expiration.

Args:
    signer (object): The signer object used for signing and unsigning operations.
    ts (datetime): The timestamp to be used for signing.
    freeze (object): The freeze object used for time manipulation.

Returns:
    void: This method does not return a value but asserts the behavior of the signer object.
</DOCSTRING>
